title: Kenyan Beef Stew
description: Hearty beef stew recipe inspired by Kenyan cuisine, perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Kenyan Stew Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at African markets or online

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add onion, garlic, and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato, potato, carrot, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add Kenyan Stew Spice Mix and stir to combine.
Return beef to pot, add nourishing greens, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
